policies.request: Original frozen Zod safeParse; no Rust implementation is invoked.
policies.response: Actual Zod execution with explicit Rust adaptations: preserve unknown object fields; widen enum/string-literal-union vocabularies; preserve required types, individual literals, catchalls, refinements, defaults and transforms.
policies.native: Native descriptors report real JS inputs and safeParse observations. They are not JSON conformance passes; Rust typed boundary equivalents must be tested separately.

nonEmptyObject(
  z
    .object({
      credit_limit: z.number().min(0).optional(),
      type: z.enum(['cost', 'tokens']).optional(),
      alert_threshold: z.number().min(0).optional(),
      periodic_reset: z.enum(['monthly', 'weekly']).nullable().optional(),
      periodic_reset_days: z.number().int().min(1).max(365).nullable().optional(),
      next_usage_reset_at: dateTime.nullable().optional(),
    })
    .strict(),
).refine(
  (value) => value.periodic_reset == null || value.periodic_reset_days == null,
  'periodic_reset and periodic_reset_days are mutually exclusive',
)
